newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight, one-week pound rates higher.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight, one-week pound rates higher.

text.p: Private-sector bankers quoted overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound at between 10 and 10 7/16 percent on Thursday, up from between 9 7/8 and 10 1/8 percent on Wednesday.
They quoted one-week rates between 10 1/16 and 10 7/16 percent, up about 1/16 from Wednesday.

The bankers also said the Central Bank has offered to borrow back their treasury bills for a two-week period to make it easier for banks to subscribe to the treasury's seven-year bonds. Banks must submit their bids by October 1.
